claims.claim: Synchronous communication requires participants to take part at the same time, while asynchronous communication does not.
Plain-language guidance emphasizes defining an audience, organizing information, using familiar and direct language, and testing whether intended communication is clear.
Accessibility should be considered throughout content work; guidance includes considering target audiences' technical literacy and defining unfamiliar terms.
Captions provide synchronized text for speech and necessary non-speech audio, supporting people who are Deaf or hard of hearing and others who process written information better than audio.
The NIST Privacy Framework frames communication about data-processing purposes, practices, associated privacy risks, and preferences or requests as part of privacy risk management.
A communication plan can make audience, information need, purpose, channel, timing, feedback, accessibility, and information boundaries explicit, but it cannot guarantee understanding or agreement.
